Explicit original USGS identity from existing historical curation; current canonical curated identity retained. USGS Sado deposit location, approximate. Gold only because silver is not among existing categories. Niigata prefecture chronology corroborates 1601 full-scale development and 1989 cessation: https://www.pref.niigata.lg.jp/site/sado-goldmine-en/sg-228.html

Explicit original USGS identity from existing historical curation; current canonical curated identity retained. 2025 is the last directly attested production year, not a closure date. Explicit original USGS identity from existing historical curation; current canonical curated identity retained. USGS major-deposit coordinate, approximate. End year is latest attested production in the consulted report, not a closure date.

Explicit original USGS identity from existing historical curation; current canonical curated identity retained. USGS major-deposit coordinate, approximate. Earlier tin/tantalum operations are not assigned to lithium. Tantalum underground care-and-maintenance phases are not lithium closures. End year is latest attested production, not a closure date.

Explicit original USGS identity from existing historical curation; current canonical curated identity retained. Operator-authored primary technical report hosted on MineDocs; LKAB report archive: https://lkab.mediaflowportal.com/documents/folder/231556/. Coordinate from SGU 2001 mineral map, entry 53 ORED00012, RT90 national grid northing 7533200 / easting 1684670 transformed to WGS84 (EPSG:3021 to EPSG:4326). Representative deposit point, approximate. USGS original point not reused because it is too far south. End year is latest attested production in this report, not closure. Iron and apatite have separate documented periods. Future rare-earth projects are not treated as historical extraction. Coordinate grid confirmed as RT90 in the accompanying SGU report.

Explicit original USGS identity from existing historical curation; current canonical curated identity retained. Approximate USGS point for the Oulad Abdoun mining district, which groups several successive workings. Earlier underground phase and recent observation are retained separately; the 1994–2023 open-pit period is left unfilled here pending a continuous operational chronology. Additional operator overview: https://www.ocpgroup.ma/en/what-we-do/industrial-operations.
